obligations.statement: Validate that the receiver is an object and a fast typed array before reading its viewed ArrayBuffer during Filter.
obligations.guard_relation: object and fast-typed-array type guards dominate GetViewedArrayBuffer and the detached-buffer check
obligations.effect: prevents an incompatible receiver from being interpreted as a typed-array view
limitations: Historical patch shape only; runtime exploitability is not established here.

notes: Created after reading the fix patch and regression test.
